name: elevenlabs
summary:
Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Steps followed exactly as documented:

1. Fetched the quickstart page at https://elevenlabs.io/docs/quickstart
2. Installed the SDK with `pip install elevenlabs python-dotenv`
3. Created `example.py` with the exact code from the quickstart (using the pre-exported ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable)
4. Ran the script with `python example.py` — audio played successfully via ffplay (already available in the sandbox)
5. Created a verification script to save the generated audio to `output.mp3` and confirmed it is a valid MP3 file (41,839 bytes, ID3 header detected)

The promised outcome is fully verified: text-to-speech successfully generated an audio file from text using the ElevenLabs API.
deviations: No deviations from the quickstart documentation were required. The sandbox already had ffplay available, so no additional installation was needed for audio playback. The ELEVENLABS_API_KEY was pre-exported in the environment, so no manual .env file creation was necessary.

env_ready.evidence: Defaulting to user installation because normal site-packages is not writeable

friction.detail: AttributeError: 'property' object has no attribute 'convert' when calling help(ElevenLabs.text_to_speech.convert) on the class instead of an instance.

The built-in play() helper requires system ffmpeg/ffplay; source code warns: "ffplay from ffmpeg not found, necessary to play audio. On mac you can install it with 'brew install ffmpeg'. On linux and windows you can install it from https://ffmpeg.org/"

friction.where: Quickstart example vs file generation promise
friction.detail: The initial example.py uses from elevenlabs.play import play and play(audio) for ephemeral playback, forcing the user to discover save(audio, \"output.mp3\") separately to actually produce the promised audio file.

inspect.signature reveals opaque Ellipsis defaults: model_id: str | None = Ellipsis, language_code: str | None = Ellipsis, voice_settings: elevenlabs.types.voice_settings.VoiceSettings | None = Ellipsis, making it hard to know which parameters are required.
